function tickCarouselAutoplay(c, timestamp): void;

Defined in: website/components/carousel/custom-carousel/autoplay.ts:161

Autoplay RAF tick: elapsed/duration → ringProgress 0–1 → paint → advance when the cycle completes, then rebase the clock for the next slide. The ring resets before goTo so the new slide starts empty.
